headline: Kerch Bridge par hamla, sadak hissa gira
detail: Ukraine ne drone aur missile se Kerch Bridge par hamla kiya; sadak wale hisse ki mehraab aur span samundar me gir gaye, rail seva aanshik roop se bahal hui.
exam_angle: Kerch Bridge, Crimea aur Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Siberia me sainya viman gira, 19 ki maut
detail: Russia ka An-12 sainya parivahan viman Kemerovo ke paas gira; raksha mantralaya ke mutabik sawaar 19 logon ki maut ho gayi, takneeki kharabi ko shuruaati wajah bataya gaya.
exam_angle: Russia, sainya viman aur An-12 — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: America-Thailand vyapar samjhota tay
detail: Manila me America aur Thailand ne parasparik vyapar samjhote (ART) par baatchit ke mool roop se poora hone ki ghoshna ki; Thailand America se aane wale saaman par tariff khatm karega.
exam_angle: ASEAN, America-Thailand vyapar aur reciprocal tariff — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Bangladesh me phir hinsa, BNP neta ki maut
detail: Faridpur me BNP neta Raju Mollah ki hatya ke baad Gopalganj me thana aur sansad ke ghar me aag lagayi gayi; Dhaka me buson me aag aur crude bomb dhamake hue.
exam_angle: Bangladesh ki rajneeti, Sheikh Hasina ki wapsi — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Kyiv ke pulon par hamla, 14 ki maut
detail: Russia ke hamle me Ukraine bhar me 14 log mare aur 78 ghayal hue; Kyiv ke Northern aur Southern pul band hue aur kai kshetron me bijli dhwast hui.
exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kyiv aur Dnipro nadi — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: America ne Qeshm missile site par hamla kiya
detail: America ne Qeshm dweep par missile launch site par hawai hamle kiye — ek American adhikari ne Reuters ko pushti ki; ye Iran ke Bahrain me American thikanon par hamle ka jawab tha. (Update: pehle Iran ne America par aarop lagaya tha, ab America ne hamle ki pushti ki hai.)
exam_angle: US-Iran yuddh, Hormuz me tanaav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Kuwait par drone hamla, Bahrain me alert
detail: Kuwait ki sena ne kaha uski vayu raksha 'shatrutapurna drone hamlo' ka jawab de rahi hai; Bahrain me bhi siren baje aur sena ne kai Irani hawai hamle rokne ka daava kiya.
exam_angle: Khadi me America-Iran tanav aur Hormuz — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Dhaka airport ke paas do bam dhamake
detail: Dhaka ke Hazrat Shahjalal airport ke bahari gate aur Jasimuddin area me do crude bam phate; teen paidal yatri mamuli roop se ghayal hue aur suraksha badha di gayi.
exam_angle: Bangladesh me rajnaitik tanav — UPSC ke liye upyogi.
image_credit: Md Shaifuzzaman Ayon, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

headline: Guinea me avaidh khanan par 224 ko saza
detail: Guinea ki adalat ne Siguiri me avaidh sone ke khanan par 224 logon ko saza di — 22 poorv adhikariyon ko do saal aur 202 khanan-mazdooron ko teen saal ki kaid.
exam_angle: Avaidh khanan aur paryavaran — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Norway-Sweden: Ukraine ko $371 million
detail: Norway aur Sweden ne Ukraine ko hathiyaron ke liye lagbhag $371 million dene ki ghoshna ki — Norway $300 million NATO ki PURL yojana ko aur Sweden 720 million kronor dega.
exam_angle: NATO ki PURL yojana aur Ukraine sahayata — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Quad ki pehli sainya abhyaas 2027 me
detail: Bharat, America, Japan aur Australia ne Manila me 2027 ke liye pehli Quad sainya abhyaas ki ghoshna ki; P-8 aur P-3C gasht viman samudri abhyaas me hissa lenge.
exam_angle: Quad, Indo-Pacific aur samudri suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Ukraine-Russia kaidi adla-badli ki taiyari
detail: Zelenskyy ne kaha Ukraine Abu Dhabi samjhaute ke baad bade paimane par kaidi adla-badli ki taiyari kar raha hai, aur Berlin me is hafte Europe-America ke saath paanch prathmiktayein tay hongi.
exam_angle: Ukraine-Russia vaarta aur kaidi adla-badli — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Jasoosi jaanch: America ko saunpa sena adhikari
detail: Britain ne Russia ke liye jasoosi ke sandeh me 10 November ko giraftar American sena adhikari ko America ki sainya hirasat me saunp diya; FBI aur MI5 jaanch me shaamil hain.
exam_angle: NATO, jasoosi aur rashtriya suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: America ne paanch Irani tanker duboye
detail: America ne Iran ke paanch tel tanker duboye; Iran ne jawab me Jordan ke Al-Azraq base par missile daage, Jordan ne 18 missile rokne ka daava kiya.
exam_angle: Hormuz, Khadi me America-Iran yuddh aur tel — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: 178 website par cyber hamla, BBC-IKEA bhi
detail: Optimizely ke tool me kharab code daalkar lagbhag 178 badi website par hamla hua; BBC, IKEA, Zoom aur Air France bhi nishane par aaye.
exam_angle: Supply-chain cyber hamla aur digital suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: America ne 26 saal baad khasra-mukt darja khoya
detail: PAHO ne ghoshna ki America ne 26 saal baad khasra unmoolan ka darja kho diya; 2026 me 5,412 mamle mile, 1991 ke baad sabse zyada.
exam_angle: Khasra, PAHO aur saarvajanik swasthya — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Trump-Xi-Putin ki pehli tri-pakshiya baithak kal
detail: Shenzhen me APEC ke kinare Trump, Xi Jinping aur Vladimir Putin ki pehli tri-pakshiya baithak guruvaar ko hogi; parmanu hathiyar, Ukraine aur Iran par charcha sambhav hai.
exam_angle: APEC, mahashakti kootneeti aur parmanu hathiyar niyantran — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Yemen me 60 Houthi thikano par hamla
detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne Yemen ke chaar pranton me Houthi ke 60 sainya thikano ko nasht karne ka daava kiya; missile surang aur drone workshop nishane par the.
exam_angle: Yemen, Houthi aur Laal Sagar suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Nvidia ki record kamai: $115.8 arab
detail: Nvidia ne teesri timahi me $115.8 arab ki record kamai ki, pichhle saal se doguni; data centre se $107.6 arab aaye aur agle quarter ke liye $130 arab ka anumaan hai.
exam_angle: AI chip, semiconductor aur data centre — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Papua New Guinea me 6.0 ka bhookamp
detail: Budhvaar ko Papua New Guinea me 6.0 teevrata ka bhookamp aaya; GFZ ke anusaar kendra Lae se 109 kilometre uttar me aur gahrai 10 kilometre thi, nuksaan ki khabar abhi nahi mili.
exam_angle: Bhookamp, Ring of Fire aur prashant kshetra — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Canary Islands par 11,000 pravasi pahunche
detail: Spain ke Canary Islands par November ke pehle pakhwade me 11,000 se zyada pravasi samundar se pahunche; chunaav se pehle Spain ne dweepon par apatkal ghoshit kiya.
exam_angle: Pravasan, Europe aur Spain chunaav — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: America ne measles-mukt darja khoya
detail: PAHO ne 26 saal baad America ka measles unmoolan darja wapas le liya; is saal 5,400 se zyada case — 1991 ke baad sabse zyada — aur ek saal se zyada lagataar sankraman ke kaaran darja gaya.
exam_angle: Swasthya, teekakaran aur WHO/PAHO — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Trump Kim se milne ko taiyaar
detail: Videsh mantri Marco Rubio ne kaha Trump Uttar Korea ke neta Kim Jong Un se milne ko taiyaar hain, lekin abhi koi baithak tay nahi hui; pehle karyakal me dono teen baar mile the.
exam_angle: America-Uttar Korea, parmanu kootneeti — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Japan ke aakaash me Russian viman
detail: Japan ne kaha do sandeh wale Russian vimanon ne Fukuoka ke paas uska hawai kshetra ullanghan kiya; Japan ne ladaku viman bheje aur Moscow se kadha virodh jataaya, 2024 ke baad pehli aisi ghatna hai.
exam_angle: Japan-Russia, hawai kshetra aur APEC — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Prague me do train takraayi, 46 ghayal
detail: Prague ke mukhya station ke paas do yatri train aamne-saamne takra gayi; 46 log ghayal hue, jinme dono driver bhi gambhir roop se ghayal hain; shuruaati jaanch me ek train ke laal signal paar karne ki aashanka hai.
exam_angle: Rail suraksha aur haadsa jaanch — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Congo me Ebola doguna, 11,000 case
detail: WHO ne kaha Congo me Ebola ke case teen mahine me dogune se zyada ho gaye — 11,000 se zyada case aur 5,400 mautein, aath pranton ke 67 swasthya kshetron me faila.
exam_angle: Ebola, WHO aur swasthya sankat — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Riyadh ki ore Houthi missile roka gaya
detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne kaha Riyadh ki taraf daagi gayi Houthi cruise missile ko hawai raksha ne rok kar nasht kar diya.
exam_angle: Yemen sangharsh aur Khadi suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Iran ka daava: Kuwait base par hamla kiya
detail: Iran ki sena ne kaha uske drone ne Kuwait ke Ali Al Salem air base par America ke Patriot system aur missile platform ko nishana banaya; Kuwait ne kaha uski vayu raksha hamlo ka jawab de rahi hai.
exam_angle: Khadi me America-Iran tanav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: FAA ne naye router lagane roke
detail: America ki FAA ne Juniper router lagana asthayi roop se roka; pichhle hafte inhi router se jude sanchar gadbadi ke karan desh bhar me udanein roki gayi thi aur lagbhag 20,000 udanein radd hui thi.

headline: Netanyahu ko jhatka: Knesset speaker badle
detail: Israel ki sansad ne Matan Kahana ko 66-52 se speaker chuna; ve Eisenkot ke Yashar dal se hain aur Netanyahu ke sahyogi Amir Ohana ki jagah lenge.
exam_angle: Israel ki rajneeti aur sansadiya vyavastha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Xi-Putin mile, bahudhruviya duniya ka vaada
detail: APEC ke kinare Shenzhen me Xi Jinping aur Vladimir Putin mile; dono ne kaha Russia aur China bahudhruviya duniya ki ore netritva karenge, aur kal Trump ke saath pehli tri-pakshiya baithak hogi.
exam_angle: APEC, China-Russia saajhedaari aur bahudhruviya vyavastha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Sona ek saal ke sabse neeche
detail: Sona lagbhag 2% girkar $3,778 prati ounce par aa gaya — September 2025 ke baad sabse neeche; mazboot dollar aur Fed ke byaaj badhane ki aashanka wajah bani.
exam_angle: Sona, dollar aur Fed ki neeti — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Rubio: Washington par koi turant khatra nahi
detail: Videsh mantri Marco Rubio ne kaha Washington par Iran ke kathit dirty bomb hamle ka koi turant khatra nahi hai; CNN ki report ko kharij karte hue unhone khufiya sroton ko jhootha bataya.
exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur parmanu suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Trump hatya sajish: Merchant ko 27 saal
detail: America ki adalat ne Pakistani nagrik Asif Merchant ko 27 saal se zyada ki saza di; 2024 me Trump aur anya netaon ki hatya ki sajish me Iran ke IRGC se jude hone ka aarop tha.
exam_angle: America-Iran, aatankwad aur nyay — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Takaichi pehli baar China pahunchi
detail: Japan ki PM Sanae Takaichi APEC shikhar sammelan ke liye Shenzhen pahunchi; Taiwan par unki tippani ke baad se tanav ke beech yeh unki pehli China yatra hai, Xi Jinping se aupcharik baithak ki sambhavna kam hai.
exam_angle: Japan-China, Taiwan aur APEC — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
image_credit: Cabinet Public Affairs Office, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0)

headline: ASEAN shikhar: Myanmar, samudra sanhita adhuri
detail: Manila mein 49va ASEAN shikhar sammelan samapt hua; 100 se zyada dastavezon par sahmati bani, lekin Myanmar sankat aur South China Sea aacharan sanhita par koi faisla nahi hua, adhyakshata Singapore ko mili.
exam_angle: ASEAN, Myanmar aur South China Sea — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: UAE duniya ka sabse surakshit desh
detail: Gallup ki 2026 Global Safety Report mein UAE pehle sthan par raha — 96% logon ne kaha raat mein akele chalna surakshit hai; Singapore bhi 96% ke saath barabar raha, jabki duniya bhar mein suraksha ki bhavna 69% par gir gayi.
exam_angle: Gallup Global Safety Report aur Law and Order Index — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Riyadh me dhamaka, do Houthi missile roke gaye
detail: Riyadh me zoradar dhamaka suna gaya, hawai adde ke paas dhuaan dikha; gathbandhan ne kaha do Houthi cruise missile roke gaye, subah ek aur missile bhi roka gaya tha.
exam_angle: Yemen, Houthi hamle aur Khadi suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Trump China pahunche, Xi ne swagat kiya
detail: Trump APEC ke liye Shenzhen pahunche; Xi Jinping ne hawai adde par unka swagat kiya — lagbhag 50 saal me pehli baar kisi Chinese neta ne mehmaan ka airport par swagat kiya, kal tri-pakshiya baithak hogi.
exam_angle: APEC, America-China-Russia tri-pakshiya baithak — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Iran sena pramukh: jawab aur bhi bhayankar hoga
detail: Iran ke sena pramukh Amir Hatami ne kaha America ke naye hamle par jawab 'aur bhi bhayankar' hoga aur America ke sahyogiyon ko bhi nishana banayega.
exam_angle: America-Iran tanav aur Khadi suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Hormuz me ADNOC jahaz par hamla, ek lapata
detail: Hormuz se guzarte ADNOC ke jahaz par hamla hua; ek chalak dal sadasya lapata aur 11 ghayal hue, UAE ki tel company ne WAM ko bataya.
exam_angle: Hormuz, Khadi me tel suraksha aur America-Iran tanav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Australia ne Israeli basne walon par pratibandh lagaye
detail: Australia ne West Bank me avaidh basti vistaar aur hinsa par teen Israeli vyaktiyon aur chaar sangathanon par pratibandh lagaye; Britain ne bhi kal aath nirman companiyon par pratibandh lagaye the.
exam_angle: West Bank, do-rashtra samadhan aur pratibandh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Peltola ne Alaska Senate seat jeeti
detail: Democrat Mary Peltola ne Alaska me Republican Dan Sullivan ko hara diya; Democrats ke Senate me 56 seat ho gaye — 2009 ke baad sabse bada bahumat.
exam_angle: America ke midterm chunav aur Senate bahumat — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
image_credit: Leah Herman, House Creative Services, Wikimedia Commons (Public domain)

headline: Nvidia ne China ko AI chip band kiye
detail: Nvidia ne America ki manzoori ke baad bhi Hopper AI chip China bhejna band kar diya; teesri timahi me $2.4 arab ke chip beche the, aage koi shipment nahi hogi.
exam_angle: America-China tech yuddh aur chip niryat niyantran — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

headline: Etihad, flydubai ne Saudi udanein aur radd ki
detail: Etihad ne Riyadh-Dammam udanein 30 November tak aur flydubai ne Riyadh-Abha udanein 27 November tak radd kar di; EASA ne Khadi ki udaan chetavni 31 January 2027 tak badha di.
exam_angle: Khadi tanav aur nagrik uddayan suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

headline: Board of Peace: Israel-Hamas ne vaade tode
detail: Trump ke Board of Peace ne apni doosri report me Israel aur Hamas dono par Gaza yuddhaviram ki shartein na nibhane ka aarop lagaya; report ke mutabik yuddhaviram khatre me hai.
exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram aur Board of Peace — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
